name: Asian Agri-History Foundation Research Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture - All Disciplines)
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an M.Sc. Agriculture program (all disciplines) at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The fellowship is awarded for a duration of one year only.
